content: ONNX Runtime on ARM64 lacks x86 AVX/AVX2 kernels; relies on Arm Neon/KleidiAI-optimized MLAS kernels instead. FP16 models can be slower than FP32 on aarch64 (e.g., Raspberry Pi) due to inserted precision-cast nodes eating up to 54% of inference time -- prefer FP32/INT8 quantized models over FP16 on ARM CPU.
